apiKey.title: Odds-API.io API key
apiKey.description: Your Odds-API.io API key. Get one at https://odds-api.io/pricing. Without a key the run saves three example rows.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: rows (default): one row per event, bookmaker, market and selection, with optional closing lines. events: one row per fixture with scores. odds: one row per event, bookmaker and market with the raw odds array. valueBets: pre-match prices above a fair-odds estimate, one row per value bet.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug, for example football, basketball, tennis, ice-hockey, esports. Full list: https://api.odds-api.io/v3/sports

league.title: League
league.description: Optional league slug, for example england-premier-league or usa-nba. Leave empty for all leagues of the sport.

bookmakers.title: Bookmakers
bookmakers.description: Comma-separated bookmaker names as listed at https://api.odds-api.io/v3/bookmakers, for example Bet365,Unibet,DraftKings. Required for every mode except events. Use bookmakers selected on your plan.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Comma-separated market names for rows and odds modes, for example ML,Spread,Totals,Player Props. Leave empty for every market the bookmaker offers.

status.title: Event status
status.description: Status filter when listing events: pending (pre-match), live (in-play), or a comma-separated list such as pending,live.

includeClosingLines.title: Include closing lines
includeClosingLines.description: rows mode only. Also save the closing odds of events that finished in the last N days (see Closing lines window) for the same sport, leagues, bookmakers and markets. Rows are marked closingLine = true. Uses /historical/closing-lines, which needs a paid Odds-API.io plan.

closingLinesDays.title: Closing lines window (days)
closingLinesDays.description: How many past days of settled events to pull closing lines for. Only used when Include closing lines is on.

maxEvents.title: Max events
maxEvents.description: Maximum number of events to list (rows, events and odds modes). In rows mode it also caps the settled events used for closing lines.

eventIds.title: Event IDs
eventIds.description: Optional Odds-API.io event IDs. When set, rows, events and odds modes fetch exactly these events instead of listing by sport, league and status.
